aaaaaaaamatroot00000000000000000.body: Top-down: China property + infrastructure stimulus is incremental, not breakout â€” coal + nickel demand stabilizes rather than accelerates. ASEAN materials de-rate vs. North Asia + Australian peers as the pricing ceiling holds firm and supply-side discipline weakens.

aaaaaaaamatmacsub000000000000000.title: China steel + power demand grows < 2% YoY in 2026 as property remains weak
aaaaaaaamatmacsub000000000000000.body: China demand: NBS infrastructure data confirms + property starts inflect modestly off the 2024 trough but remain 30-40% below 2021 peak. Steel + power demand grow at the lower end of historical range, capping bulk-commodity prices.

aaaaaaaamatmacassump000000000000.title: No major Chinese stimulus break-out (CNY 5tn+ package) in 2026
aaaaaaaamatmacassump000000000000.body: Base case: China's 2026 stimulus stays incremental, no breakout fiscal package. Violation flips the entire thesis â€” a CNY 5tn+ infrastructure package would re-rate ASEAN materials sharply and flip ASEAN-vs-North-Asia dynamics.
aaaaaaaamatmacassump000000000000.if_violated: Thesis flips: ASEAN materials become 2026 buy; nickel + coal break out 20-30%.

aaaaaaaamatmaccat000000000000000.title: China March 2026 Two Sessions (NPC + CPPCC)
aaaaaaaamatmaccat000000000000000.body: Annual policy-setting meeting where the GDP target + fiscal deficit + key industrial policy guidelines are announced. Outcome directly resolves the stimulus-size assumption.
aaaaaaaamatmaccat000000000000000.expected_impact: GDP target ~5% / deficit 3.0-3.5% â€” stimulus stays incremental.

aaaaaaaamatindsub000000000000000.title: ASEAN nickel sector capex discipline weakens, supply grows 8-10% YoY
aaaaaaaamatindsub000000000000000.body: Industry: Indonesian + Philippine nickel producers add smelter capacity (HPAL + RKEF) on schedule â€” sector supply grows 8-10% YoY against 2-4% demand growth. Pressures spot nickel prices into 2027 and compresses ASEAN producer margins ahead of the cycle.

aaaaaaaamatindmetric000000000000.body: Track LME daily settlement. Sustained sub-$15,000 indicates supply-side dominance has broken pricing power; sustained above $20,000 invalidates the supply-glut sub-thesis.

aaaaaaaamateqadro000000000000000.title: ADRO: thermal-coal cash flow stays defensive but multiple compresses 2-3 turns
aaaaaaaamateqadro000000000000000.body: Single-name: Adaro Energy's thermal-coal cash generation remains intact at ~$80-90/t Newcastle, but the equity de-rates 2-3 turns of P/E as ESG outflows + flat-volume thesis weigh on multiple. Net: -10 to -15% return over 12M vs. JCI.

aaaaaaaamateqques000000000000000.title: HRUM: nickel pivot exposure is mispriced â€” re-rates if nickel breaks $18,000
aaaaaaaamateqques000000000000000.body: Single-name: Harum Energy's pivot from coal to nickel is structurally complete by H2 2026. Equity is priced as a coal stub; an LME nickel break above $18,000 forces re-rating to nickel-pure-play multiples (15-20x vs. current 8x). Optionality, not base case.
